name: overflow
description: When your Codex allowance is nearly gone, delegate the work to friends whose Codex is idle and spend what is left on directing and judging.

interface.shortDescription: Keep working when Codex is nearly out.
interface.longDescription: Overflow checks your remaining Codex allowance when a session starts. Below 15% it turns the session into an orchestrator: it packages the work, sends it to friends whose Codex is idle, and returns their results into the same conversation. Waiting costs no allowance. Run `overflow earn` to put your own idle Codex into a friend's pool.
interface.defaultPrompt: How much Codex allowance do I have left, and can this task be delegated?
